verdict.rationale: Justworks docs show a Custom Payroll Report export and a Xero integration that maps pay types to ledger accounts, which supports manual reconciliation into a ledger, but there is no evidence of a public payroll API for an agent to pull data programmatically — probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI specs both returned 404. missing for 10: documented payroll API/export endpoint an agent could call, evidence of automated/agent-driven reconciliation workflow, any developer API docs.
